init_model: create a Model instance with TimeSeriesData and params to initialize a forecasting model
fit_model: fit the Model to training data by calling the fit method on a Model instance
predict_model: call predict on a fitted Model instance to generate forecast results stored in fcst_df
plot_forecast: plot forecast results with optional confidence intervals and history using the Model plot method
validate_inputs: validate the inputs for a forecasting model by calling validate_inputs on a Model instance
